ontent":[{"type":"bullet_list","attrs":{"indent":0,"dataDiffId":"2ee75a0c-6cef-49e7-9e44-a215aa8b15aa","nodeId":"33a1e629cc7a465b8396c4eb62a5d887"},"content":[{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-c274c48d-213b-4a72-892b-80ad164cd7e9","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"74d7461876f8443ea9942b63cb0be5ec"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"c2924242-40fa-4747-9661-7f322af9a20a","nodeId":"40b4e24581c844fd9d7dfce602708926"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"释义："},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"即高级黑、低级红的缩写。"}]}]}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"f95b1f96-75fb-41f9-a0f7-0bc406826720","nodeId":"2ef92017a2be48aba5a2608963c4c00b"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"高级黑"},{"type":"text","text":"：指明褒实贬、指桑骂槐，用看似赞美或客观的包装来进行讽刺和攻击，伪装性更强。如果说“低级红”常常是“低能之错”，“高级黑”则更多被视作居心叵测。"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"93d370db-229e-4543-ab99-c67bd4efde3f","nodeId":"6724d96f005840bfb1c89e7f5515ce5c"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"低级红"},{"type":"text","text":"：指有意无意地把正面主张简单化、庸俗化，用夸张、极端甚至违背常理的方式表达“政治正确”，结果适得其反。它往往是“用力过猛”的捧，本想表扬，反而引发反感。"}]},{"type":"bullet_list","attrs":{"indent":0,"dataDiffId":"cc41c7d2-2c45-44a8-8fc1-a098f9588a0f","nodeId":"48d59883836344a995e836e47f264879"},"content":[{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-7805f69a-a565-461f-a4f8-13c3af412ca8","fontSize":null,"value":null,"nodeId":"2f7ccd14dde342f8a9427555e45e08a6"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"6c400dfd-0d0a-493b-92db-02827e7b5faf","nodeId":"38419c5fc46f42b6a663858634fb97fe"},"content":[{"type":"text","text":"举例（仅做名词解释，非打标案例）："}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"4f63b30b-2b09-44a2-bd0c-fd228652c8a5","nodeId":"0346346b3b7a4e12b93959eac2bf9afd"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"高级黑："},{"type":"text","text":"山东德州市作家协会发布了一份“廉洁文化主题文学作品征文”获奖名单，一篇题为"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"《我的县长父亲》"},{"type":"text","text":"的散文获得了一等奖。（在“廉洁文化”征文这个特定语境下，用“我的县长父亲”做标题，天然触发了公众对特权、拼爹的敏感神经。它可能并非作者有意抹黑，但客观上让一场本应正面的廉洁宣传，演变成了一场对公平性的全民嘲讽，产生了“明褒实贬、授人以柄”的效果。）"}]},{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"ed885a61-eaeb-4d86-a186-0effb43a86ed","nodeId":"f68afed1b64946a3acfea88f2e144608"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"低级红"},{"type":"text","text":"：黑龙江省某法院曾在其网络宣传文章中，表扬一位名叫“默然”的执行局干警，称她“"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"strong"}],"text":"28天连续加班，没换过衣服，没洗过头"},{"type":"text","text":"”，并将其塑造为“女神、女超人”。（文章本意是颂扬敬业奉献精神，但为了突出先进，刻意制造苦情、违背了基本的生活常识和人情常理。这种“用力过猛”的宣传非但没有让人感动，反而引发了舆论反感，把一个正面典型写成了不近人情的“怪人”，属于典型的“低级红”——用极端、庸俗的方式表达“政治正确”，结果适得其反。）"}]}]}]}]}]}]},{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-59ff2142-9a28-4b05-ad82-c376ac9e9d87","fontSize":15,"value":null,"nodeId":"a91112acffbb4142a4d16937fea74080"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"d3d1c17b-80f8-496b-b517-ebb1ddd0e1bc","nodeId":"7f23a7a1ba004b3b9f4095a6bbc9be52"},"content":[{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"造谣抹黑"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}},{"type":"strong"}],"text":"国家重要领导人"},{"type":"text","marks":[{"type":"color","attrs":{"color":"#000"}},{"type":"font","attrs":{"dataSize":15}}],"text":"及其家属私生活/党派斗争/家族背景关系；"}]}]},{"type":"list_item","attrs":{"level":0,"hidden":false,"dataListItemDiffId":"ct-list-item-diff-id-bd7e8e74-1037-4bf6-b6c7-8a6cd3000f64","fontSize":15,"value":null,"nodeId":"0740bf558a6047219d99de10b2f94b06"},"content":[{"type":"paragraph","attrs":{"indent":0,"align":"","dataDiffId":"6bacc800-1b94-469d-a377-98d783e20837","nodeId":"
